coarse_skill_concept: Read, filter, and convert tabular data between formats (CSV, Parquet, JSON) using pandas and Python standard library file I/O.

task_judgments.reason: The entire task is a direct pandas read_csv → to_parquet format conversion with no filtering logic required.

CSV reading and JSON writing are trivial wrappers; the dominant challenge is multi-pass fuzzy entity resolution (Levenshtein distance, account normalization, typo handling), which is a fundamentally different procedure.

final_groups.skill_concept: Convert a CSV file to a binary columnar format (Parquet) using pandas and pyarrow with no row/column transformation.
final_groups.reasoning: Task requires only format conversion: read CSV into a DataFrame and serialize to Parquet. No filtering, fuzzy matching, or business logic involved.

final_groups.skill_concept: Filter CSV rows via fuzzy/typo-tolerant entity matching (Levenshtein distance on company names and account numbers) and serialize matching rows to a sorted JSON array.
final_groups.reasoning: The core skill is identifying records belonging to the same real-world entity despite typos using approximate string matching, multi-pass account discovery, and character-substitution normalization—not tabular format conversion.
